nodes.notes: Pick your Google Calendar credential once

parameters.content:
## PainPal · Calendar sync (physio)
Every 30 min (or **Sync now**): reads Google Calendar events with "physio" in the title (yesterday → next 7 days) and adds new ones to the **schedule** table.

B4 /log and B6 /dashboard use it: a physio appointment within 2 h after a dose shortens the predicted relief, and the dashboard shows a physio heads-up.

**Setup:** Google Calendar credential in the calendar node · Publish.
**Owner:** Person B · built by n8n/build.js
